recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless the build starts publishing the historical proposal note or a future Subscription example reintroduces an Observation criteria search.
issue_request: FHIR-8832 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Subscription technical correction asking that example Subscription criteria use Observation?code=http://loinc.org|1975-2 rather than Observation?name=http://loinc.org|1975-2.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 7155, imported as git commit 987e5fc8279a762452d4d545d722001d2b6aa6c0, which changed source/subscription/subscription-example.xml and source/subscription/subscription-example-error.xml from Observation?name to Observation?code.
additional_context: Subscription remains active in source/fhir.ini, but the current resource model uses Subscription.filterBy rather than the old Subscription.criteria element. The active current example list contains Subscription/example and Subscription/admission, neither of which includes the LOINC Observation criteria. Later Subscription changes, including FHIR-12723 and FHIR-27129, refactored the examples and removed the old error example. A source search found the old Observation?name text only in source/subscription/josh proposal.txt, which has no source reference indicating current build inclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current built Subscription source already avoids the incorrect criteria and editing an unreferenced proposal note would not correct the current specification.

related_jiras.note: Later Subscription example/resource reordering preserved the corrected Observation?code criteria in the then-current XML examples.
Later SubscriptionStatus refactoring removed the old subscription-example-error.xml example that FHIR-8832 had corrected.
